title: What Is an IPO? Explained in 60 Seconds
description:
An IPO is when a company first sells shares to the public. In India, SEBI oversees IPOs and companies publish offer documents with risk factors. Shares can list below their issue price.

Sources:
• Investor.gov: Initial public offerings: https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing/investing-basics/glossary/initial-public-offering-ipo
• SEBI: Guide to understand an offer document: https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/docfiles/20612_t.html
• NSE: How to invest in an IPO (PDF): https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/web/sites/default/files/inline-files/How_to_invest_in_Intial_Public_Offer.pdf
